aciklama: Held-out text GENESIS is measured on and never learns from. The on-chain loss (GenesisDil.kayip, milli-bits per byte; 8000 = no better than chance) on these sentences is recorded to memory as category 9 after every learning round, so whether learning helped is a number on chain, not a claim.
